example: Are you on your tod tonight - where's your missus?
你今晚是一個人嗎？——你老婆去哪裡了？

NONE: B2 used more generally to mean the present time

example: What's the date today?
今天幾號？
He's going to call you at some point today.
他今天某個時候要給你打電話。
Today is even hotter than yesterday!
今天甚至比昨天還熱！
Is that today's paper?
那是今天的報紙嗎？
He should be back today a week today (= one week from today).
他一個星期後的今天回來。
Today, people are much more concerned about their health than they were in the past.
現在人們比過去更關心自己的健康。
With today's technology almost anything seems possible.
有了今天的技術，似乎萬事可逹。
The youth of today don't know how lucky they are.
如今的年輕人不知道他們有多幸運。

NONE: › used to express the hope that success already achieved in one place will be continued in other places in the future
今日北美，明日世界（用於表達希望已在一個地方取得成功之後，將來在其他地方仍要繼續取得成功）

example: "We've just about cornered the market in Europe." "Well, today Europe, tomorrow the world".
「我們幾乎佔領了歐洲市場。」「好，今日歐洲，明日世界！」

NONE: › (especially of a young child) to walk with short steps, trying to keep the body balanced

example: I watched my two-year-old nephew toddling around after his puppy.
我看著兩歲的侄子跟在他的小狗後面蹣跚地四處走。
I'm just toddling off/round to the shops.
我只是出去逛逛商店。

NONE: C2 a young child, especially one who is learning or has recently learned to walk
（尤指處於學步期或剛學會走路的）幼童
